The metric indoor model was fine-tuned using Apple\'s Hypersim synthetic indoor dataset. Hypersim is licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0.

Hi Paafekt Support Team,

I need help with:
How do I create a room?
Tap Create Room, then take or choose a photo. Select AI Room for an automatic estimate or Manual Setup to define the room yourself. Save the finished room to add it to your Room Library.
How do I take a photo to create a room?
When creating a room, choose Take a Photo. You can pick Standard (1x) or Wide Angle (0.5× ultra-wide). Hold your device steady and tap capture. The photo is then used to build your 3D room.
What is the difference between AI Room and Manual Setup?

AI Room estimates room dimensions from one photo and displays that photo on a measured plane in the 3D viewer. It is not a full volumetric reconstruction. Manual Setup lets you define a five-surface room for a more controllable representation.

AI Room uses Depth Anything V2 Metric Indoor Small for metric depth, RTMDet furniture anchors, and GeoCalib for camera calibration. It estimates dimensions and displays the source photo on a measured plane in the 3D viewer; it is not a full volumetric room reconstruction.
Manual Setup lets you define the room boundaries directly on the photo for greater control over the resulting representation.
Choose AI Room for a faster automatic estimate. Choose Manual Setup when you want direct control over room boundaries. If one result is unsuitable, try the other method.
What kind of photos work best?
For best results, take photos in good lighting with the camera held level. Try to capture the entire room including floors, walls, and ceiling edges. Avoid blurry or dark photos.
Why is my room generation failing?
Room generation may fail if the photo is too dark, blurry, or doesn\'t show enough room features. Try taking a new photo with better lighting and a wider angle.
How many rooms can I create?
You can save up to 20 rooms. Delete rooms you no longer need to make space. The Room Library shows the current room count and total storage used.
How do I save a room?
After generating a 3D room, tap the room to summon controls, then tap the save icon (download arrow) and enter a name. If you leave a preview without saving, that room is discarded.
Rooms are stored in Paafekt\'s private app storage on this device and aren\'t uploaded automatically. Internal location: files/rooms.

No. Room creation, furniture detection, and Placement Intelligence run on this device. Firebase separately processes phone-number authentication and abuse-prevention data. Content leaves Paafekt only when you explicitly share it.
What does the Fit button do?

Tap Fit to detect a furniture item and create a transparent cutout over your 3D room. Drag the cutout to position it and pinch to resize it. Fit is a visual preview; measured dimensional guidance requires AR-assisted sizing.
What does full-video mode do in the room viewer?

While Fit is active, summon controls and tap the viewfinder icon to toggle full-video mode. You get a live camera feed with detection boxes—tap one or more items, then tap Segment. The camera hides and transparent cutouts composite over your 3D room. Tap Done (top-right) to exit segment mode or leave Fit entirely.
How do I take a screenshot?
Tap the room to summon controls, then tap Capture. This saves the current view (including furniture overlays when Fit is on) to your gallery.
Furniture segmentation detects an item in the camera view and separates its visible pixels from the background so it can appear as a movable cutout. Processing runs on this device.
How do I segment furniture in the room viewer?

Tap Fit in the room viewer. For a quick check it auto-segments the main item. To pick specific pieces: summon controls, enable full-video mode, point the camera at the furniture, tap detection boxes, then tap Segment. Tap Done (top-right) to exit.
Why isn\'t my furniture being detected?
Object detection works best with clear, well-lit environments where furniture is clearly visible. Make sure the object isn\'t partially hidden or too far from the camera.
How do I view my 3D room?

Tap any room on the home screen to open the 3D viewer. Drag to look around and pinch to zoom. Tap the room to summon extra controls (recenter, ruler, Capture). The gold Fit button stays visible at bottom-right.
How do I navigate inside the room?

Drag on the room to orbit the camera and pinch to zoom. Tap the screen to summon the toolbar, then tap Recenter to restore the default view. The small control at bottom-left also brings the toolbar back when hidden.
How do I show or hide viewer controls?

The room viewer uses immersive mode—controls hide for a clean view. Tap the room to summon the toolbar. The gold Fit button at bottom-right is always visible. While Fit is active, Done appears top-right to exit segmentation.
What does the MB number mean?
The MB (megabytes) shown in rooms indicates the file size. This helps you manage storage. The total storage used by all rooms is shown at the top of the home screen.
How do I place furniture in my room?
After you tap Segment, the selected furniture appears as an overlay in the room. Drag to position it and pinch to resize it.
How accurate are room and furniture measurements?
Measurements are on-device estimates and can vary with photo quality, lighting, camera angle, and AR tracking. Use them as guidance and confirm important dimensions yourself before making decisions.

You cannot edit AI room dimensions manually. After saving, summon controls and tap the ruler to see estimated width, height, and depth. During the pre-save preview, dimension chips are hidden—save the room first, then reopen to see measurements. Manual rooms follow the boundaries you draw.
AR-assisted sizing estimates a furniture item\'s dimensions using supported camera and depth capabilities. Results depend on capture quality and tracking conditions and remain estimates.
What is the small measurement readout?

The furniture size pill appears only when sizing mode is on and the app has a usable live height estimate. The ruler button shows the current room width, height, and depth in a small card. On non-AR phones, these readings are less reliable, especially for furniture.
The furniture mask looks wrongly zoomed—what can I do?
There is no overflow menu now. If the overlay looks off, tap Done to exit Fit and tap Fit again, or pinch the furniture manually to fine-tune its size.
What happens when I pinch the segmented furniture?

Pinching makes the furniture overlay larger or smaller. If sizing mode is on and the Furni pill is visible, that pill updates to the current resized furniture estimate for the room. If sizing mode is off, pinch only changes the overlay visually on screen.
Does taking a photo in the app help room quality?
Yes. On supported devices, choosing Take a photo (instead of picking from the gallery) uses the in-app camera with depth where available, which can improve how your 3D room is built and scaled.

Can I add multiple furniture pieces?
In full-video mode, select several detection boxes and tap Segment to create their cutouts together. You can also segment one item at a time with the default Fit flow.
How do I check if furniture fits?

After segmentation, turn on AR sizing for measured furniture width and height. Placement Intelligence compares those values and derived depth with the room envelope. You can still drag and pinch the cutout for visual comparison.
Placement Intelligence compares an item\'s estimated width, height, and derived depth with the room envelope. It reports dimensional compatibility only and does not identify a free floor location.
How does the app pick a color for aesthetic scoring?

The app averages the straight RGB color of visible pixels inside the AI furniture cutout (the same segmented overlay you see on camera). That mean color is compared with colors sampled from your room\'s floor, walls, and ceiling. If either sample is unavailable, the card says aesthetic guidance is unavailable instead of inventing a score.
What do harmony, contrast, and style fit mean?

These are simple design heuristics, not a judgment of taste. Harmony describes how the furniture color relates to the room palette (for example analogous or complementary hues). Contrast is how different the brightness is from typical floor or wall colors. Style fit compares broad style labels inferred for the room with a default modern profile, so it is approximate.
When might aesthetic scores look low or show "clash"?

Bright, saturated objects often score worse when their hue does not line up with the app\'s harmonious color schemes against your room—for example acid green, magenta, purple, or safety-orange props against warm beige or tan rooms, or loud primaries in a room sampled as mostly one hue family. Very similar brightness to the floor or wall (brown-on-brown, gray-on-gray) can lower contrast even if you like the look. Rooms inferred as rustic or traditional can show lower style fit because the furniture profile uses default modern/minimal tags. Dull gray or muddy averages from busy backgrounds may land in a neutral band instead of clash. Treat scores as guides only and trust your eye for real decor.
What happens to my rooms if I uninstall Paafekt?
Uninstalling Paafekt permanently removes rooms stored in its private app storage. Share anything you want to keep before uninstalling.
How do I back up or export a room?

Use Share when it is available for that room type. Capture shares an image of the current view, not a restorable room backup. Paafekt does not currently provide cloud sync or a guaranteed full-library backup.
Does Placement Intelligence find an available location on the floor?
No. It checks whether estimated furniture dimensions are compatible with the room envelope. It does not detect free floor space or identify a specific open location.

The item\'s estimated width, height, and derived depth are compared with the room\'s estimated dimensions, including a rotated footprint where helpful. Because both sets of dimensions are estimates, treat the result as guidance.
How is the aesthetic score calculated?

The app compares the average visible color of the segmented furniture with colors sampled from the room. Harmony, brightness contrast, and broad style compatibility contribute to the score. These are approximate design heuristics, not rules of taste.
Aesthetic guidance requires usable color samples from both the room and the segmented furniture. If either sample is unavailable, Paafekt shows no score rather than inventing one.
Can I rely on Paafekt when purchasing furniture?
Use Paafekt as a guide, not a guarantee. Always confirm dimensions, clearances, and suitability with the seller before buying.
What happens when I delete my account?

Deleting your account removes the Firebase authentication account and signs you out. Rooms saved on this device are not deleted automatically; delete them in Paafekt or uninstall the app to remove them.

Firebase processes your phone number, authentication records, and a device installation identifier used for verification and abuse prevention. Room creation and furniture processing remain on this device.
